s.t: "Look at my face, and you will see that I am not the man."
s.fr: « Regardez mon visage, et vous verrez que je ne suis pas l’homme que vous cherchez. »

s.t: "Swear it," James said.
s.fr: « Jure-le, » dit James.

s.t: "I swear it," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Je le jure, » dit Dorian.

paras.summary: Dorian says he does not know Sibyl Vane, dead 18 years, and that no one has called him the Prince. He tells James to look at his face and swears he is not the man.

s.t: James took Dorian to a lamp and looked at his face.
s.fr: James entraîna Dorian sous un réverbère et scruta son visage.

s.t: The face was young and beautiful, and it was not more than 20 years old.
s.fr: C’était un visage jeune et beau, celui d’un garçon de vingt ans tout au plus.

s.t: James put down his gun, and his hands were not steady.
s.fr: James abaissa son revolver, et ses mains tremblaient.

s.t: "I would have killed a man who did nothing," James said.
s.fr: « J’aurais tué un homme qui n’avait rien fait, » dit James.

s.t: "Go, and forgive me."
s.fr: « Partez, et pardonnez-moi. »

s.t: Dorian ran away into the dark, and he did not look back.
s.fr: Dorian s’enfuit dans l’ombre sans se retourner.

paras.summary: James takes Dorian to a lamp and sees a young face of no more than 20. He puts down his gun, says he would have killed an innocent man, and tells Dorian to go, and Dorian runs away.

s.t: The woman came out of the dark and took James by the hand.
s.fr: La femme sortit de l’ombre et prit James par la main.

s.t: "Why did you not kill him?" she asked.
s.fr: « Pourquoi ne l’as-tu pas tué ? » demanda-t-elle.

s.t: "He gave his soul to the devil, and I have known him for 18 years."
s.fr: « Il a vendu son âme au diable, et je le connais depuis dix-huit ans. »

s.t: "He is 38 years old, but his face is young, and he does not grow old."
s.fr: « Il a trente-huit ans, mais son visage est jeune, et il ne vieillit pas. »

s.t: James ran after Dorian, but Dorian was gone.
s.fr: James courut après Dorian, mais celui-ci avait disparu.

paras.summary: The woman asks why James did not kill him and says Dorian gave his soul to the devil and is 38 with a young face. James runs after him, but he is gone.

s.t: Dorian did not stop until he came to his house, and he locked the door.
s.fr: Dorian ne s’arrêta qu’une fois arrivé chez lui, et il ferma la porte à clé.

s.t: He sat in the room and thought about the sailor, and he was afraid.
s.fr: Il s’assit dans le salon et pensa au marin, et la peur le saisit.

s.t: His young face had saved him that night, but he knew that James Vane would look for him again.
s.fr: Son jeune visage l’avait sauvé cette nuit-là, mais il savait que James Vane se remettrait à sa recherche.

s.t: He did not sleep, and he did not go up to the room at the top of the house.
s.fr: Il ne dormit pas, et il ne monta pas dans la pièce tout en haut de la maison.

paras.summary: Dorian runs home and locks the door. He knows his young face has saved him tonight but that James Vane will look for him again, and he does not sleep.

s.t: A week later Dorian was at Selby with a party of friends.
s.fr: Une semaine plus tard, Dorian recevait des amis à Selby.

s.t: Lord Henry was there, and so was Lady Narborough, and they sat with Dorian in a room full of roses.
s.fr: Lord Henry était là, ainsi que lady Narborough, et ils étaient assis avec Dorian dans un salon rempli de roses.

s.t: "You look tired, Dorian," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « Vous avez l’air fatigué, Dorian, » dit lord Henry.

s.t: "I am tired, Harry, and I have not slept well," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Je suis fatigué, Harry, et j’ai mal dormi, » dit Dorian.

s.t: "Have you heard about Basil?" Lord Henry asked.
s.fr: « Savez-vous la nouvelle, pour Basil ? » demanda lord Henry.

paras.summary: A week later Dorian is at Selby with friends, including Lord Henry and Lady Narborough. Lord Henry says Dorian looks tired, and Dorian says he has not slept well.

s.t: "He has not come back from Paris, and men are looking for him."
s.fr: « Il n’est pas revenu de Paris, et on le recherche. »

s.t: "Men say that someone killed him."
s.fr: « On dit que quelqu’un l’a tué. »

s.t: "Do not say that!" Dorian cried, and his face grew white.
s.fr: « Ne dites pas cela ! » s’écria Dorian, et il devint blême.

s.t: Dorian looked up, and he saw a face at the window.
s.fr: Dorian leva les yeux, et il aperçut un visage à la fenêtre.

s.t: It was the face of a man with dark eyes, and the man was looking at him.
s.fr: C’était le visage d’un homme aux yeux sombres, et cet homme le regardait.

paras.summary: Lord Henry says men are looking for Basil and that some say he was killed. Dorian cries out, then sees the face of a man with dark eyes looking at him from the window.

s.t: Dorian cried out again and fell to the floor, and everyone ran to him.
s.fr: Dorian poussa un nouveau cri et s’effondra sur le sol, et tout le monde accourut.

s.t: Lord Henry lifted him up, and Dorian said, "I saw a face at the window."
s.fr: Lord Henry le releva, et Dorian dit : « J’ai vu un visage à la fenêtre. »

s.t: "It was only a bird," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « Ce n’était qu’un oiseau, » dit lord Henry.

s.t: The servants looked in the garden, but they found no one.
s.fr: Les domestiques fouillèrent le jardin, mais ils ne trouvèrent personne.

s.t: Dorian said nothing, but he knew that the face was the face of James Vane.
s.fr: Dorian ne dit rien, mais il savait que ce visage était celui de James Vane.

paras.summary: Dorian falls to the floor, and Lord Henry lifts him up and says it was only a bird. The servants find no one, but Dorian knows it was James Vane.

s.t: The next day the men went out to shoot, and Dorian went with them.
s.fr: Le lendemain, les hommes partirent à la chasse, et Dorian les accompagna.

s.t: He walked with Sir Geoffrey Clouston, and he was afraid.
s.fr: Il marchait aux côtés de sir Geoffrey Clouston, et il avait peur.

s.t: A hare ran by, and Sir Geoffrey lifted his gun.
s.fr: Un lièvre détala devant eux, et sir Geoffrey épaula son fusil.

s.t: "Do not shoot it!" Dorian cried.
s.fr: « Ne tirez pas ! » s’écria Dorian.

s.t: "It is only a hare," Sir Geoffrey said, and he laughed and shot.
s.fr: « Ce n’est qu’un lièvre, » dit sir Geoffrey en riant, et il tira.

s.t: The hare fell, and then a man cried out in the bushes.
s.fr: Le lièvre roula à terre, puis un homme poussa un cri dans les buissons.

paras.summary: The next day Dorian goes shooting with the men, afraid. When a hare runs by, Dorian tells Sir Geoffrey Clouston not to shoot, but he does, and a man cries out in the bushes.

s.t: The men ran to the bushes, and they found a man there.
s.fr: Les chasseurs se précipitèrent vers les buissons, et ils y trouvèrent un homme.

s.t: He was dead, and he had the clothes of a sailor.
s.fr: Il était mort, et il portait des vêtements de marin.

s.t: Dorian looked at the dead man's face, and it was the face of James Vane.
s.fr: Dorian regarda le visage du mort, et c’était celui de James Vane.

s.t: "He is dead," Dorian said, and for the first time in many days he was not afraid.
s.fr: « Il est mort, » dit Dorian, et pour la première fois depuis bien des jours, il n’avait plus peur.

paras.summary: The men find a dead man in the bushes who wears the clothes of a sailor. Dorian sees that he is James Vane, and for the first time in many days he is not afraid.

s.t: The men at Selby said that the death of the sailor was an accident, and Sir Geoffrey was sorry.
s.fr: À Selby, on conclut que la mort du marin était un accident, et sir Geoffrey en fut navré.

s.t: Dorian did not tell anyone that he knew the dead man, and he went back to London the next day.
s.fr: Dorian ne dit à personne qu’il connaissait le mort, et il rentra à Londres le lendemain.

s.t: That night he slept for the first time in many days.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, il dormit pour la première fois depuis bien des jours.

s.t: He thought of James Vane and the gun, and he thought of the young face that had saved him.
s.fr: Il pensa à James Vane et à son revolver, puis au jeune visage qui l’avait sauvé.

s.t: "I am safe now, for no one is looking for me," he said to himself.
s.fr: « Me voilà à l’abri, car plus personne ne me cherche, » se dit-il.

paras.summary: The men at Selby say the sailor's death was an accident, and Dorian tells no one he knew the man. Back in London he sleeps well and thinks he is safe.

s.t: Later Lord Henry came to the house, and his face was strange.
s.fr: Plus tard, lord Henry vint à la maison, et son visage avait un air étrange.

s.t: "I have bad news, Dorian," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « J’ai une mauvaise nouvelle, Dorian, » dit lord Henry.

s.t: "Alan Campbell is dead."
s.fr: « Alan Campbell est mort. »

s.t: "He shot himself in his room, and his servant found him this morning."
s.fr: « Il s’est tiré une balle dans sa chambre, et son domestique l’a trouvé ce matin. »

s.t: "There was a letter on the table, but it did not say why he did it."
s.fr: « Il y avait une lettre sur la table, mais elle ne disait pas pourquoi il avait fait cela. »

s.t: Dorian sat down and did not speak for a time.
s.fr: Dorian s’assit et resta un moment sans parler.

paras.summary: Lord Henry comes with bad news: Alan Campbell shot himself, and a letter on his table gave no reason. Dorian sits without speaking.

s.t: "Why did he do it?" Dorian asked at last.
s.fr: « Pourquoi a-t-il fait cela ? » demanda enfin Dorian.

s.t: "No one knows," Lord Henry said, "but he was a strange man, and he lived alone."
s.fr: « Personne ne le sait, dit lord Henry, mais c’était un homme étrange, et il vivait seul. »

s.t: "You were his friend once, Dorian, and you knew him better than I did."
s.fr: « Vous avez été son ami, autrefois, Dorian, et vous le connaissiez mieux que moi. »

s.t: "We have not spoken for years," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Nous ne nous parlions plus depuis des années, » dit Dorian.

s.t: "He was the best man in London for chemistry," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « C’était le meilleur chimiste de Londres, » dit lord Henry.

paras.summary: Dorian asks why Alan did it, and Lord Henry says no one knows. Dorian says he and Alan have not spoken for years.

s.t: Dorian sat still and thought of the night in the room at the top of his house.
s.fr: Dorian restait immobile, et il songeait à cette nuit-là, dans la pièce tout en haut de sa maison.

s.t: Alan was dead, and no one else knew what had been done in that room.
s.fr: Alan était mort, et personne d’autre ne savait ce qui s’était fait dans cette pièce.

s.t: Dorian felt cold, but he did not feel sorry.
s.fr: Dorian eut froid, mais il n’éprouva aucun regret.

s.t: "You have a strange face, Dorian," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « Vous avez un air étrange, Dorian, » dit lord Henry.

paras.summary: Dorian remembers the night in the locked room, since with Alan dead no one else knows what was done there. Lord Henry says his face looks strange.

s.t: "I have thought too much about death this week, Harry," Dorian said.
s.fr: « J’ai trop pensé à la mort cette semaine, Harry, » dit Dorian.

s.t: "Come and eat with me tonight, and we will talk about other things," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « Venez dîner avec moi ce soir, et nous parlerons d’autre chose, » dit lord Henry.

s.t: "Not tonight, for I want to be alone," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Pas ce soir, car je veux être seul, » dit Dorian.

s.t: Lord Henry went away, and Dorian sat in the room until it was dark.
s.fr: Lord Henry s’en alla, et Dorian resta assis dans la pièce jusqu’à la nuit tombée.

paras.summary: Dorian says he has thought too much about death. He refuses Lord Henry's invitation to eat and stays alone until dark.

s.t: A few days later Dorian ate dinner at the house of Lord Henry, and the two men sat alone by the fire.
s.fr: Quelques jours plus tard, Dorian dîna chez lord Henry, et les deux hommes s’installèrent seuls au coin du feu.

s.t: Dorian did not speak for a long time.
s.fr: Dorian resta longtemps sans parler.

s.t: "Harry, I have decided to be good," he said at last.
s.fr: « Harry, j’ai décidé d’être bon, » dit-il enfin.

s.t: Lord Henry laughed and asked, "Since when, Dorian?"
s.fr: Lord Henry rit et demanda : « Depuis quand, Dorian ? »

s.t: "Since I went to Selby last week," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Depuis mon séjour à Selby, la semaine dernière, » dit Dorian.

paras.summary: A few days later Dorian dines with Lord Henry and says he has decided to be good. He says it began when he went to Selby.

s.t: "There was a girl in a village near Selby, and her name was Hetty Merton."
s.fr: « Il y avait dans un village près de Selby une jeune fille qui s’appelait Hetty Merton. »

s.t: "She was pretty and simple, and she told me that she loved me."
s.fr: « Elle était jolie et toute simple, et elle m’a dit qu’elle m’aimait. »

s.t: "I could have taken her to London, and she would have gone with me."
s.fr: « J’aurais pu l’emmener à Londres, et elle m’aurait suivi. »

s.t: "I looked at her for a long time, and I knew that I could do wrong to her."
s.fr: « Je l’ai longuement regardée, et je savais que je pouvais lui faire du mal. »

s.t: "I did not do it, Harry."
s.fr: « Je ne l’ai pas fait, Harry. »

s.t: "I left her in the village, and she is still a good girl."
s.fr: « Je l’ai laissée dans son village, et elle est restée une honnête fille. »

s.t: "It is the first good thing that I have done in my life."
s.fr: « C’est la première bonne action de toute ma vie. »

paras.summary: Dorian tells of Hetty Merton, a pretty and simple girl in a village near Selby who said she loved him. He could have taken her to London but left her alone, and it was his first good act.

s.t: Lord Henry laughed again and said, "You are a strange man, Dorian, and I do not believe you."
s.fr: Lord Henry rit de nouveau et dit : « Vous êtes un homme étrange, Dorian, et je ne vous crois pas. »

s.t: "A girl who loves a man is not saved when he goes away."
s.fr: « Une jeune fille qui aime un homme n’est pas sauvée parce qu’il s’en va. »

s.t: "She will cry for a month, and then she will marry a farmer and forget you."
s.fr: « Elle pleurera un mois, puis elle épousera un fermier et vous oubliera. »

s.t: "Or she will die, as Sibyl Vane died, and then you will have done a good thing for nothing."
s.fr: « Ou bien elle mourra, comme est morte Sibyl Vane, et vous aurez fait une bonne action pour rien. »

s.t: "Do not speak of Sibyl Vane, Harry," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Ne parlez pas de Sibyl Vane, Harry, » dit Dorian.

paras.summary: Lord Henry does not believe him and says the girl will cry, marry a farmer, and forget him, or die as Sibyl did. Dorian tells him not to speak of Sibyl.

s.t: "I wanted to do one good thing, and I did it, and I am glad."
s.fr: « Je voulais faire une bonne action, je l’ai faite, et j’en suis heureux. »

s.t: "I think that I will be better if I do more good things."
s.fr: « Je crois que je deviendrai meilleur si je fais d’autres bonnes actions. »

s.t: "You will not be good for long, Dorian," Lord Henry said, and he smiled.
s.fr: « Vous ne resterez pas bon bien longtemps, Dorian, » dit lord Henry en souriant.

s.t: "We are the same, you and I, and you cannot change what you are."
s.fr: « Nous sommes pareils, vous et moi, et vous ne pouvez pas changer ce que vous êtes. »

s.t: Dorian looked at the fire and did not answer.
s.fr: Dorian regarda le feu et ne répondit pas.

s.t: He thought of the picture, and he wondered if the mouth was less cruel now.
s.fr: Il songea au portrait, et il se demanda si la bouche était désormais moins cruelle.

paras.summary: Dorian says he is glad of his good act and hopes to do more, but Lord Henry says he will not be good for long. Dorian looks at the fire and wonders if the picture has changed.

s.t: Lord Henry smoked for a time, and then he asked a question.
s.fr: Lord Henry fuma un moment, puis il posa une question.

s.t: "Tell me, Dorian, what do you think happened to Basil?" Lord Henry asked.
s.fr: « Dites-moi, Dorian, à votre avis, qu’est-il arrivé à Basil ? » demanda lord Henry.

s.t: "I do not know," Dorian said, and he did not look at Lord Henry.
s.fr: « Je n’en sais rien, » dit Dorian, et il évita le regard de lord Henry.

s.t: "Men say that he was killed, but I do not believe it," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « On dit qu’il a été tué, mais je n’en crois rien, » dit lord Henry.

s.t: "Basil was a good man who had no enemies, and no one kills a man like that."
s.fr: « Basil était un brave homme qui n’avait pas d’ennemis, et on ne tue pas un homme pareil. »

paras.summary: Lord Henry asks what Dorian thinks happened to Basil. Dorian says he does not know, and Lord Henry says he does not believe Basil was killed because he had no enemies.

s.t: "Suppose that I told you that I killed him, Harry," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Et si je vous disais que c’est moi qui l’ai tué, Harry ? » dit Dorian.

s.t: Lord Henry laughed and said, "I would not believe you."
s.fr: Lord Henry rit et répondit : « Je ne vous croirais pas. »

s.t: "Crime is for common men, and you are not a common man."
s.fr: « Le crime, c’est bon pour les gens du commun, et vous n’êtes pas du commun. »

s.t: "A man who has your face does not kill anyone."
s.fr: « Un homme qui a votre visage ne tue personne. »

s.t: "You do not know me, Harry," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Vous ne me connaissez pas, Harry, » dit Dorian.

paras.summary: Dorian asks what if he said he had killed Basil. Lord Henry laughs and says a man with his face does not kill, and Dorian says Lord Henry does not know him.

s.t: "I know that you are my best friend," Lord Henry said, "and you are the same as you were 18 years ago."
s.fr: « Je sais que vous êtes mon meilleur ami, dit lord Henry, et que vous êtes le même qu’il y a dix-huit ans. »

s.t: "Tell me, Dorian, how do you keep your youth?"
s.fr: « Dites-moi, Dorian, comment faites-vous pour garder votre jeunesse ? »

s.t: "You must have a secret, for you have not changed at all."
s.fr: « Vous devez avoir un secret, car vous n’avez pas changé du tout. »

s.t: "I have no secret," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Je n’ai pas de secret, » dit Dorian.

s.t: "I am tired of the life that you taught me, Harry, and I am afraid."
s.fr: « Je suis las de la vie que vous m’avez appris à mener, Harry, et j’ai peur. »

s.t: "You told me to live, and I lived, and I did not know what it would cost me in the end."
s.fr: « Vous m’avez dit de vivre, et j’ai vécu, sans savoir ce qu’il m’en coûterait au bout du compte. »

paras.summary: Lord Henry says Dorian has not changed in 18 years and asks his secret. Dorian says he has none and is tired and afraid of the life Lord Henry taught him.

s.t: "You must not talk like this, Dorian," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « Il ne faut pas parler ainsi, Dorian, » dit lord Henry.

s.t: "You are the most beautiful man in London, and you will be young for years."
s.fr: « Vous êtes le plus bel homme de Londres, et vous resterez jeune pendant des années encore. »

s.t: "Play me something on the piano before you go, and do not think about sad things."
s.fr: « Jouez-moi quelque chose au piano avant de partir, et ne pensez plus à ces tristes choses. »

s.t: "I cannot play tonight, Harry, for I am too tired," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Je ne peux pas jouer ce soir, Harry, car je suis trop fatigué, » dit Dorian.

s.t: "We will meet at the club tomorrow, Dorian," Lord Henry said.
s.fr: « Nous nous verrons demain au cercle, Dorian, » dit lord Henry.

s.t: "I will not be at the club," Dorian said, and he took his hat.
s.fr: « Je ne serai pas au cercle, » dit Dorian, et il prit son chapeau.

s.t: Lord Henry looked at him for a long time, and Dorian went out of the house into the night.
s.fr: Lord Henry le regarda longuement, et Dorian quitta la maison et s’enfonça dans la nuit.

paras.summary: Lord Henry says Dorian will be young for years and asks him to play the piano. Dorian says he is too tired, will not be at the club, and leaves.

s.t: Dorian walked home through the empty streets, and he thought only of the picture.
s.fr: Dorian rentra à pied par les rues désertes, et il ne pensait qu’au portrait.

s.t: He went up to the room at the top of the house and opened the door with his key.
s.fr: Il monta jusqu’à la pièce tout en haut de la maison et ouvrit la porte avec sa clé.

s.t: He put the lamp on the table and took the cloth from the picture.
s.fr: Il posa la lampe sur la table et retira l’étoffe qui couvrait le portrait.

s.t: The face in the picture was not better, and the mouth had a smile on it that was false.
s.fr: Le visage du portrait n’était pas meilleur, et sur la bouche flottait un sourire faux.

s.t: There was red on the hands in the picture, and the red was wet.
s.fr: Il y avait du rouge sur les mains du portrait, et ce rouge était humide.

paras.summary: Dorian goes home and up to the locked room and takes the cloth off the picture. The mouth has a false smile, and the hands are red and wet.

s.t: "I did one good thing, and the picture is worse," Dorian said.
s.fr: « J’ai fait une bonne action, et le portrait a empiré, » dit Dorian.

s.t: He thought of Hetty Merton and the village, and he thought about why he had left the girl alone.
s.fr: Il pensa à Hetty Merton et au village, et il réfléchit aux raisons pour lesquelles il avait laissé la jeune fille en paix.

s.t: He had not left the girl alone because he was a good man.
s.fr: Ce n’était pas par bonté qu’il avait laissé la jeune fille en paix.

s.t: He had done it because he wanted to look at the picture and see that it was beautiful again.
s.fr: Il l’avait fait parce qu’il voulait regarder le portrait et le voir redevenu beau.

s.t: "It was only vanity, and I was playing at a good man," he said.
s.fr: « Ce n’était que vanité, et je jouais à l’homme de bien, » dit-il.

paras.summary: Dorian says he did one good thing and the picture is worse. He sees he left Hetty alone only because he wanted the picture to be beautiful again, and that it was vanity.

s.t: He thought of Basil, and he thought of the red on the hands, and he thought of telling the police what he had done.
s.fr: Il pensa à Basil, au rouge sur les mains, et il songea à tout avouer à la police.

s.t: "No one could prove it, for the body is gone and Alan Campbell is dead," he said.
s.fr: « Personne ne pourrait le prouver, car le corps a disparu et Alan Campbell est mort, » dit-il.

s.t: "Only the picture speaks against me, and no one but me has seen it."
s.fr: « Seul le portrait témoigne contre moi, et personne d’autre que moi ne l’a vu. »

s.t: "As long as the picture is in this room, I will not be free."
s.fr: « Tant que ce portrait sera dans cette pièce, je ne serai pas libre. »

paras.summary: Dorian thinks of telling the police about Basil but knows no one could prove it, since the body is gone and Alan is dead. Only the picture speaks against him, and he will not be free while it is in the room.

s.t: He looked around the room and saw the knife on the table.
s.fr: Il parcourut la pièce du regard et aperçut le couteau sur la table.

s.t: He had used it to kill Basil, and he had cleaned it many times until nothing was left on it.
s.fr: Il s’en était servi pour tuer Basil, et il l’avait nettoyé tant de fois qu’il n’y restait plus aucune trace.

s.t: He took the knife in his hand and stood in front of the picture.
s.fr: Il prit le couteau en main et se planta devant le portrait.

s.t: "It has killed the painter, and it will kill the painter's work," Dorian said.
s.fr: « Il a tué le peintre, et il tuera l’œuvre du peintre, » dit Dorian.

s.t: "It will kill the past, and when the past is dead, I will be free."
s.fr: « Il tuera le passé, et quand le passé sera mort, je serai libre. »

paras.summary: Dorian takes the knife that killed Basil and stands before the picture. He says it will kill the painter's work and the past, and then he will be free.

s.t: Dorian went to the picture and pushed the knife into it from the top to the bottom.
s.fr: Dorian s’approcha du portrait et y enfonça le couteau, le fendant de haut en bas.

s.t: There was a cry, and there was the sound of a man falling to the floor.
s.fr: Il y eut un cri, puis le bruit d’un homme qui s’écroulait sur le plancher.

s.t: The cry was so terrible that the servants woke in their beds.
s.fr: Le cri fut si effroyable que les domestiques se réveillèrent en sursaut dans leurs lits.

s.t: Two men who were walking in the street below stopped and looked up at the house.
s.fr: Deux hommes qui passaient dans la rue en contrebas s’arrêtèrent et levèrent les yeux vers la maison.

s.t: They went to the door and knocked, and Francis came down and opened it.
s.fr: Ils allèrent frapper à la porte, et Francis descendit leur ouvrir.

paras.summary: Dorian stabs the picture from top to bottom. A terrible cry wakes the servants, and two men in the street knock at the door, and Francis opens it.

s.t: "Someone cried out at the top of this house," one of the men said.
s.fr: « Quelqu’un a crié tout en haut de cette maison, » dit l’un des hommes.

s.t: "I heard it, and I did not know what it was," Francis said.
s.fr: « Je l’ai entendu, mais je ne savais pas ce que c’était, » dit Francis.

s.t: Francis took a lamp, and the two men followed him up the stairs.
s.fr: Francis prit une lampe, et les deux hommes le suivirent dans l’escalier.

s.t: They knocked at the door of the locked room, but no one answered.
s.fr: Ils frappèrent à la porte de la pièce fermée à clé, mais personne ne répondit.

s.t: Francis had not seen that room for many years, for his master kept the key.
s.fr: Francis n’avait pas vu cette pièce depuis bien des années, car son maître en gardait la clé.

s.t: The door would not open, and they pushed it until it broke.
s.fr: La porte résistait, et ils poussèrent jusqu’à l’enfoncer.

paras.summary: One of the men says someone cried out at the top of the house, and Francis says he heard it. They go up with a lamp and push in the door of the locked room.

s.t: They stood at the door for a moment before they went into the room.
s.fr: Ils restèrent un instant sur le seuil avant d’entrer dans la pièce.

s.t: The lamp on the table was still burning, and the room was cold.
s.fr: La lampe brûlait encore sur la table, et il faisait froid dans la pièce.

s.t: On the wall of the room hung a picture of a young man.
s.fr: Au mur de la pièce était accroché le portrait d’un jeune homme.

s.t: It was the picture that Basil Hallward had painted, and it was as beautiful as on the day that it was finished.
s.fr: C’était le portrait qu’avait peint Basil Hallward, et il était aussi beau qu’au jour où il avait été achevé.

s.t: On the floor lay a dead man in evening clothes, and there was a knife in his heart.
s.fr: Sur le plancher gisait un mort en habit de soirée, un couteau planté dans le cœur.

s.t: The man was old, and his face was full of lines, and it was terrible to look at.
s.fr: L’homme était vieux, son visage était couvert de rides, et ce visage faisait horreur.

paras.summary: The men go in, and on the wall is Basil's picture, as beautiful as on the day it was finished. On the floor lies an old dead man with a knife in his heart.

s.t: "Who is he?" one of the men asked.
s.fr: « Qui est-ce ? » demanda l’un des hommes.

s.t: "I do not know him, for no one in this house is so old," Francis said.
s.fr: « Je ne le connais pas, car personne dans cette maison n’est aussi vieux, » dit Francis.

s.t: But when they looked at his hands, they saw the rings on his fingers.
s.fr: Mais quand ils regardèrent ses mains, ils virent les bagues à ses doigts.

s.t: By the rings they knew that the dead man was Dorian Gray.
s.fr: À ces bagues, ils comprirent que le mort était Dorian Gray.

paras.summary: Neither man nor servant knows the old man, but by the rings on his hands they know he is Dorian Gray.
